# HyperOS Plugin (HyperOS 1) **Modded SystemUI plugin for HyperOS 1 and MIUI 13–14 with many features unlocked.** [![Release](https://img.shields.io/github/v/release/Mods-Center/HyperOS-Plugin?style=for-the-badge&label=release&color=0a84ff)](https://github.com/Mods-Center/HyperOS-Plugin/releases/latest) [![Downloads](https://img.shields.io/github/downloads/Mods-Center/HyperOS-Plugin/total?style=for-the-badge&color=30d158)](https://github.com/Mods-Center/HyperOS-Plugin/releases) [![Stars](https://img.shields.io/github/stars/Mods-Center/HyperOS-Plugin?style=for-the-badge&color=ffd60a)](https://github.com/Mods-Center/HyperOS-Plugin/stargazers) [![Telegram](https://img.shields.io/badge/Telegram-channel-26A5E4?style=for-the-badge&logo=telegram&logoColor=white)](https://t.me/kashis_cringey_stuffs)
## Features - New control center UI - Choose how many tiles are shown - Custom colours for tiles and toggles - Settings toggle for all ROMs - Super volume boost up to 200% - Fixes the volume slider icon disappearing on MIUI ROMs ## Requirements - HyperOS 1 or MIUI 13–14 - Android 12 or newer - Magisk ## Installation 1. Download the latest zip from [**Releases**](https://github.com/Mods-Center/HyperOS-Plugin/releases/latest). 2. Flash it in Magisk, KernelSU or APatch. 3. If the panel doesn't open, reboot once more. 4. Reboot your device. ## Notes - MIUI 14 (Android 13) and newer: Signature verification must be disabled. Flash [Apk Protection Patch](https://github.com/Mods-Center/Apk-Protection-Patch) or [Apk Signature Verification Patch](https://github.com/Mods-Center/Apk-Signature-Verification-Patch) first, or use the Core Patch LSPosed module. ## Screenshots

HyperOS Plugin (HyperOS 1)

Modded SystemUI plugin for HyperOS 1 and MIUI 13–14 with many features unlocked.

![Release](https://github.com/Mods-Center/HyperOS-Plugin/releases/latest)

![Downloads](https://github.com/Mods-Center/HyperOS-Plugin/releases)

![Stars](https://github.com/Mods-Center/HyperOS-Plugin/stargazers)

![Telegram](https://t.me/kashis_cringey_stuffs)

Features

  • New control center UI
  • Choose how many tiles are shown
  • Custom colours for tiles and toggles
  • Settings toggle for all ROMs
  • Super volume boost up to 200%
  • Fixes the volume slider icon disappearing on MIUI ROMs

    • Requirements

  • HyperOS 1 or MIUI 13–14
  • Android 12 or newer
  • Magisk

    • Installation

  • Download the latest zip from [**Releases**](https://github.com/Mods-Center/HyperOS-Plugin/releases/latest).
  • Flash it in Magisk, KernelSU or APatch.
  • If the panel doesn't open, reboot once more.
  • Reboot your device.

    • Notes

  • MIUI 14 (Android 13) and newer: Signature verification must be disabled. Flash [Apk Protection Patch](https://github.com/Mods-Center/Apk-Protection-Patch) or [Apk Signature Verification Patch](https://github.com/Mods-Center/Apk-Signature-Verification-Patch) first, or use the Core Patch LSPosed module.
